label: Diagram 1.9
caption: Diagram 1.9 | Measuring tapered treads Spiral and helical stairs
description: The image is Diagram 1.9, "Measuring tapered treads", showing two plan views of curved stairs. Top left reads "See paras 1.25–1.27". The upper plan is a curved stair with tapered treads divided by radial lines, with a dashed arc marking the curved stair line and dashed straight lines at the top and left forming a rectangular closure around the outer corners of the treads. A vertical dimension on the right is labelled "Stair width less than 1m". Two bottom segments are each marked "Equal". A dimension at the bottom right measures the width of a tread at its narrow end, labelled "50mm minimum tread width at narrow end". Below the upper plan, on the left, text reads "Measure going at centre of tread; measure from curved stair line, even when tread is in rectangular closure". The lower plan shows a longer curved stair with a dashed centre line. Its top-right dimension reads "Stair width 1m or more". Labels include "Width", "Going (not more than maximum for stair category see para 1.3)", "Going (not less than minimum for stair category see para 1.3)", and "Landing length measured on centre line". Two bottom dimensions each read "270mm".
